content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Nagpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 21-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Nagpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the AIIMS Nagpur recruitment is 21 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this AIIMS Nagpur recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the posts of Project Research Scientist-I, Project Nurse-III, and Project Technical Support-II.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for AIIMS Nagpur recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts is 35 years, with potential relaxation as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the AIIMS Nagpur recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply by sending their complete application with all necessary documents via email before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Project Research Scientist-I?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Research Scientist-I post is Rs. 56,000 plus 20% HRA, totaling Rs. 67,200 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What are the educational qualifications for Project Nurse-III?
faq.answer: For the Project Nurse-III position, candidates must have a minimum Second Class or equivalent CGPA in a four-year Nursing Course.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for AIIMS Nagpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process may include a Written Test (if required), followed by an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, these positions are on a contract basis as per the details provided in the notification.
